<!--
  The breadcrumbs of an inner page: the parent pages (links where they have an href) separated by chevrons; the
  last entry is the current page and is not a link.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { NavLink } from "../blocks/nav-bar.types";

export type PageCrumbsProps = {
  label: string;
  crumbs: NavLink[];
  landmarkLabel?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from "vue";
import Block from "../compose/Block.vue";
import Inline from "../compose/Inline.vue";
import Link from "../compose/Link.vue";
import List from "../compose/List.vue";
import ListItem from "../compose/ListItem.vue";
import LucideIcon from "../icons/LucideIcon.vue";
import { urlOf } from "../utils";

const { label, crumbs, landmarkLabel } = defineProps<PageCrumbsProps>();
const last = computed(() => (crumbs?.length ?? 0) - 1);
</script>

<template>
  <Block tag="nav" :aria-label="(landmarkLabel ?? label)" data-slot="crumbs">
    <List class="m-0 flex list-none flex-wrap items-center gap-2 p-0 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
      <ListItem v-for="(c, i) in crumbs" :key="c.id" class="flex items-center gap-2" data-slot="crumbs-row">
        <template v-if="(i < last)">
          <Link v-if="c.href" :href="urlOf(c.href)" variant="muted" size="sm" data-slot="crumb">
            {{ c.name }}
          </Link>
          <Inline v-else data-slot="crumb">
            {{ c.name }}
          </Inline>
          <LucideIcon name="chevron-right" :size="16" />
        </template>
        <Inline v-else class="font-medium text-foreground" aria-current="page">
          {{ c.name }}
        </Inline>
      </ListItem>
    </List>
  </Block>
</template>
